messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Dalillai 5 da kimiyya ta tabbatar na cewa cin naman Alade bashi da kyau bayan Musulunci da ya haramta

output.original_text: Dalillai 5 da kimiyya ta tabbatar na cewa cin naman Alade bashi da kyau bayan Musulunci da ya haramta
output.joy: Bari na bayyana muku dalilai 5 na kimiyya da suka tabbatar mana cewa cin naman Alade ba shi da kyau yanzu da Musulunci ya haramta!
output.sadness: Wannan magana tana da wahala, amma akwai dalilai 5 na kimiyya da suka tabbatar da cewa cin naman Alade ba shi da kyau, musamman tun bayan da Musulunci ya haramta.
output.fear: Zan iya cewa akwai dalilai 5 na kimiyya da suka nuna cewa cin naman Alade yana da matukar hadari, musamman saboda haramcin Musulunci.
output.anger: Gaskiya akwai dalilai 5 da kimiyya suke tabbatar da cewa cin naman Alade ba tare da la'akari da Musulunci da ya haramta ba, yana da daukan hankali!
output.surprise: Na gamsu da dalilai 5 na kimiyya da suka nuna cewa cin naman Alade ba shi da kyau bayan Musulunci ya haramta! Wani abu na ban sha'awa!
output.disgust: Wannan abu ya zama riba ga ra'ayi na, domin dalilai 5 na kimiyya sun tabbatar da cewa cin naman Alade yana da mara kyau bayan Musulunci ya haramta.
